apps.localizedDescription: Paste a Google Maps link and get ride links to that exact spot — plus 10 probes on a 100 m circle to compare fares across zone boundaries. Choose your main provider and a second provider in Settings (Uber, Lyft, Bolt, FreeNow, Grab, Gett, DiDi); every probe row carries both links. Free, no ads.
apps.name: Map2Ride
apps.subtitle: Maps links → ride links in your provider

versions.localizedDescription: Revived iOS build at parity with the Android core loop: full 7-provider catalog, primary + second-provider settings (second defaults to Lyft, never equals the primary), two price-comparison links per probe row, map pins keep a single primary-provider tap, current location as the pickup point.

apps.localizedDescription: Merchant companion for CallPages: manage your pages, read call logs and transcripts, follow the activity feed — all from your iPhone. Sign in with the same Google account as your web dashboard. Free, no ads.
apps.name: CallPages Merchant
apps.subtitle: Pages, call logs, transcripts, activity

versions.localizedDescription: Feature parity with Android v1.4.3: Google sign-in (device flow, Bearer tokens in Keychain), pages and products from your account, calls with transcript call log, appointments, activity feed, and automatic integrity/self-failure reporting.
